quizName:
DMV Practice Test  #22
										  					
  

40 Questions • Passing Score 32

questions.question: When a traffic signal turns green, what should you do?

options.text: Speed up as fast as you can.
Wait for another driver to wave you on.

questions.explanation: A green light means you can go. However, you must first let pedestrians and other traffic in the intersection finish crossing or moving.

questions.question: Two vehicles enter an intersection from different roads at the same time. Which vehicle must yield?
questions.explanation: When two vehicles arrive at an intersection at the same time, the vehicle on the left must yield to the vehicle on the right.

questions.question: What is the correct order of traffic light colors from top to bottom?
questions.explanation: Traffic lights are always arranged with red on top and green on the bottom. When arranged side by side, red is on the left and green is on the right.

questions.question: You are driving on a road with two solid yellow lines. When can you cross them?

options.text: Only to turn left into an alley, private road, or driveway
To pass other vehicles if no traffic is coming

questions.correctAnswerText: Only to turn left into an alley, private road, or driveway
questions.explanation: Double solid yellow lines mean you cannot pass. You can only cross them to turn left into an alley, private road, or driveway.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that there is a steep hill ahead.

questions.question: When turning left onto a one-way street, which lane should you turn into?

options.text: The lane closest to where you came from

questions.correctAnswerText: The lane closest to where you came from
questions.explanation: Always turn into the lane that is closest to your previous lane.

questions.question: When must you pull over for an emergency vehicle?

options.text: No matter which direction it is coming from
Only if it is behind you
Only if it is coming toward you

questions.correctAnswerText: No matter which direction it is coming from
questions.explanation: You must pull to the right edge of the road and stop for any emergency vehicle with flashing lights, whether it is coming from behind or from the opposite direction.

questions.question: You see a flashing yellow light at an intersection. What should you do?

options.text: Stop and wait for the light to change
Make a U-turn because the intersection is closed
Drive slowly and carefully through the intersection
Get ready to stop; the light is about to turn red

questions.correctAnswerText: Drive slowly and carefully through the intersection
questions.explanation: A flashing yellow light means proceed slowly with caution. Look both ways before entering the intersection.

questions.question: Which of these does NOT help with safe night driving?

options.text: Know that tinted windows reduce visibility at night
Carry a flashlight in your vehicle
Stare into the headlights of oncoming vehicles

questions.correctAnswerText: Stare into the headlights of oncoming vehicles
questions.explanation: Looking at oncoming headlights makes your eyes smaller. After the car passes, your eyes need time to adjust back to the darker light. During this time, you cannot see well.

questions.question: A vehicle with high beams is coming toward you. Where should you look?

options.text: The right side of the road
The left side of the road

questions.correctAnswerText: The right side of the road
questions.explanation: When a vehicle with high beams does not dim them, look toward the right side of the road. This keeps you from being blinded and lets you stay on your path until the vehicle passes.

questions.question: When turning left on a multilane, one-way street or highway, which lane should you start from?
questions.explanation: Always start a left turn from the left lane on multilane streets and highways.

questions.question: Your vehicle is blocking traffic after an accident. What should you do?

options.text: Move your vehicle off the road if possible.
Do not move your vehicle under any circumstances.
Wait for police to arrive before moving your vehicle.

questions.correctAnswerText: Move your vehicle off the road if possible.
questions.explanation: After an accident, move your vehicle off the road if you can. Do not leave the scene without giving your information and offering help.

questions.question: You turn onto a two-lane road with a broken yellow line in the center. What does this tell you?

options.text: Traffic moves in both directions on this road.
Traffic moves in only one direction on this road.
You must stay to the left of the broken yellow line.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic moves in both directions on this road.
questions.explanation: Yellow centerlines separate traffic moving in opposite directions. A broken yellow line means you may cross it to pass slower traffic when it is safe.

questions.question: At an intersection with no stop line or crosswalk marking, where should you stop?

options.text: You do not have to stop.
Slow down to check that crossing traffic is clear.
Stop where you can see 200 feet in each direction, even if you must enter the intersection.
Stop where you can clearly see oncoming traffic before entering the intersection.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop where you can clearly see oncoming traffic before entering the intersection.
questions.explanation: Stop at the point closest to the intersection where you can see approaching traffic. Do not enter the intersection to get a better view.

questions.question: When driving to a place you do not know, what should you do?

options.text: Rely on road signs to guide you.
Plan your trip before you start driving.
You only need to know roughly where you are going.

questions.correctAnswerText: Plan your trip before you start driving.
questions.explanation: Plan your trip in advance before driving to an unfamiliar area. Check the location on a map before you leave.

questions.question: When should you leave extra space between your vehicle and the one in front of you?

options.text: When stopped at a stop sign.
When stopped at a toll plaza.

questions.explanation: Leave extra space in front of your vehicle when stopped on an uphill slope. If the vehicle ahead rolls backward, you will have room to avoid a collision.

questions.question: What effect does drinking coffee have on blood alcohol level after drinking alcohol?

options.text: It cancels out the alcohol's effects.
It has no effect on blood alcohol level.

questions.correctAnswerText: It has no effect on blood alcohol level.
questions.explanation: Coffee does not lower your blood alcohol level. It may help you stay awake, but it cannot change your blood alcohol level or make you sober.

questions.question: What do pennant-shaped signs mean?
questions.explanation: Pennant-shaped signs mark no passing zones. The sign will also have text to confirm it is a no passing zone.

questions.question: What should drivers do when driving in bad weather?

options.text: Drive faster to reach their destination sooner.

questions.explanation: When driving on wet roads, increase the distance between your vehicle and the one ahead of you.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that an intersection is coming. Watch carefully for traffic crossing your path.

questions.question: When you approach a railroad crossing with no flashing lights or gates, you should:

options.text: Cross the tracks immediately as fast as possible.
Always stop before crossing the tracks.
Be ready to yield to any train at the crossing.
Speed up to get across before a train comes.

questions.correctAnswerText: Be ready to yield to any train at the crossing.
questions.explanation: Always be ready to yield to trains before crossing railroad tracks, especially when there are no lights or gates. Do not cross until your entire vehicle can fit on the other side. Do not shift gears while crossing because your vehicle might stall.

questions.question: A fully loaded tractor-trailer going 55 mph needs up to ____ feet to stop completely.
questions.explanation: Large trucks stop more slowly than cars at the same speed. A fully loaded tractor-trailer can take about 400 feet to stop when traveling at 55 mph.

questions.question: Which is a safe way to drive through a curve?

options.text: Slow down when entering, speed up when exiting.
Keep the same speed throughout the curve.
Speed up when entering, slow down when exiting.
Stay close to the right edge of your lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down when entering, speed up when exiting.
questions.explanation: Slow down as you enter a curve. Then gradually increase speed as you leave it. Speeding up when entering a curve makes it harder to control your vehicle.

questions.question: You can park or stop on a freeway shoulder:

options.text: If you turn on your emergency flashers.
If no part of your vehicle is on the road.
If you need to check a map for directions.

questions.explanation: You cannot park on a freeway shoulder except when there is an emergency.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign is placed at the start of one-way streets and ramps. It tells you not to go in that direction.

questions.question: The correct way to use a freeway exit ramp is to:

options.text: Slow down before you enter the exit ramp.
Slow down after you move onto the exit ramp.
Keep your speed the same once in the exit ramp.
Pass slower cars in the exit ramp.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down after you move onto the exit ramp.
questions.explanation: When using an exit ramp, do not slow down until you are on the ramp.

questions.question: This road sign means:

options.text: Turn right after making a complete stop.

questions.explanation: Regulatory signs show laws that drivers must follow. This sign means right turns are not allowed in this location.

questions.question: A work zone:

options.text: Is marked with black and white signs.
Does not require you to slow down and pay attention.

questions.explanation: Work zones can be stationary or moving, such as vehicles striping roads, mowing, or removing snow. Work zones have orange signs with black letters or symbols. Always slow down and stay alert in work zones.

questions.question: What should you do when you see this sign?

options.text: Look for a train station ahead.
Slow down and let trains pass first.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and let trains pass first.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a railroad crossing is ahead. Always slow down when approaching railroad tracks. Trains cannot stop for cars, so you must wait for them to pass.

questions.question: If there are two railroad tracks next to each other:

options.text: It is always safe to go after one train passes.
You must always stop before crossing the tracks.
After one train passes, check the other track for another train before going.
Honk your horn as you cross the tracks.

questions.correctAnswerText: After one train passes, check the other track for another train before going.
questions.explanation: With two railroad tracks side by side, watch for a second train after the first one passes. Do not cross until you are sure no train is coming on either track.

questions.question: What do pentagonal signs indicate?
questions.explanation: Pentagonal signs show you are in a school zone. Watch carefully for children and pedestrians when driving near a school.

questions.question: What should you do when approaching a railroad crossing without traffic signals?

options.text: Always come to a complete stop.
Slow down and be ready to stop.
All railroad crossings have signals, so this will never happen.
Speed up to cross the tracks quickly.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and be ready to stop.
questions.explanation: Slow down when approaching an unmarked railroad crossing. Look both ways for trains before crossing. If you see or hear a train, stop at a safe distance and wait until the train passes.

questions.question: Before turning left, you should:

options.text: Move to the right side of your lane.
Wait for oncoming traffic to get a red light.

questions.explanation: When turning left at a traffic light, let pedestrians and oncoming traffic pass first. They have the right of way.

questions.question: A driver extends their left arm downward. What does this hand signal mean?
questions.explanation: When a driver's left arm points downward, they are signaling that they will stop. Adjust your driving if you are following this vehicle.

questions.question: What does a solid yellow arrow on a traffic signal mean?

options.text: It is never used on traffic signals.
It means the same as a yellow circular traffic light.
You may turn in the direction the arrow points.
A green arrow will appear next.

questions.correctAnswerText: It means the same as a yellow circular traffic light.
questions.explanation: A solid yellow arrow means the same as a yellow traffic light. Slow down and get ready to stop when you see it.

questions.question: Regulatory signs are usually ____ colored and must always be obeyed.
questions.explanation: Regulatory signs are white with black text. They control traffic movement and drivers must always follow them.

questions.question: Guide signs are ____ signs that give directions and distances to drivers.
questions.explanation: Guide signs have green backgrounds and show directions and distances to places. They help drivers find their way in unfamiliar areas.

questions.question: For drivers 21 and older, it is illegal to drive with a blood alcohol concentration (BAC) of:
questions.explanation: Drivers age 21 or older cannot legally drive with a BAC of 0.08 percent or higher. Driving under the influence is illegal and dangerous.

questions.question: You cannot pass another vehicle within ____ of a railroad crossing.
questions.explanation: Do not pass another vehicle within 100 feet of a railroad crossing. Only pass where other drivers can see your vehicle clearly.

questions.question: What is a "No zone"?

options.text: The blind spot around a large vehicle
An area for motor vehicles only

questions.correctAnswerText: The blind spot around a large vehicle
questions.explanation: "No zones" are large blind spots around trucks and big vehicles. Avoid staying in these blind spots while driving.
